name: Drawn Onward
source:
A decrepit, abandoned mansion, full of forgotten memories and aspirations, is as good a shelter as a recently fallen angel can hope to find. No humans to frighten, enough space to explore (and in so many ways), and no need to pay for the luxury of living within its walls. Too bad the angel isn't the only supernatural being to lay claim to the mansion...

A curse has been laid upon this place, and a promise has gone unkept. And so for the better part of a century, a ghostly painter and his demon thrall have bickered and fought over their shared predicaments. Naturally, they both see the angel as their way out...but who will the angel help?

[From [url=https://mooncakesfrommars.itch.io/drawn-onward]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一座破旧、废弃的宅邸，充满了被遗忘的记忆和愿望，是刚刚堕落的天使所希望找到的最好的庇护所。没有人类可供恐惧，有足够的空间可供探索（以及以多种方式），并且无需为在围墙内的奢华生活付费。不幸的是，天使并不是唯一拥有这座宅邸的超自然生物……

这个地方受到了诅咒，而承诺却没有兑现。因此，在一个世纪的大部分时间里，一位幽灵画家和他的恶魔奴隶一直在为他们共同的困境而争吵和斗争。自然，他们都将天使视为自己的出路……但天使会帮助谁呢？

[来自[url=https://mooncakesfrommars.itch.io/drawn-onward]itch.io[/url]]
